notes:
## Changes

- **Share a folder as a torrent.** Right-click a folder and choose Share as a torrent. Video Shelf makes a .torrent of the scenes you tick, together with their contact sheets, laid out as they are on the drive. You can add trackers (remembered for next time), make it private, and add a comment. When it's done you can copy the magnet link, open the torrent in your torrent program, or open the folder. Nothing is copied, and making the torrent doesn't go online.
- **Contact sheets now go in a "Contact sheets" folder inside the videos' folder**, so a torrent of the folder shares them too. Nothing else is added there, and the videos are only read.
- **Contact sheets already made can be skipped.** If some sheets are already there, you can keep them and make only the rest, instead of replacing them all.
- **See each sheet as it's made.** While sheets are being made, the window shows the last one finished (click it to see it full size) and about how long is left, so you can stop early if something looks wrong.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
